Het probleem is dat Astro geen client-side reactivity heeft zoals React of Vue. De variabele `menuOpen` en de functie `toggleMenu` werken alleen tijdens build/tijd van rendering, niet in de browser. Daarom werkt het hamburgermenu niet.

De oplossing is om het openen/sluiten van het menu met client-side JavaScript te doen. Dit kan door een klein script toe te voegen dat het menu toont/verbergt bij klikken op het hamburgermenu.

Wil je een pure JavaScript-oplossing of mag het met een framework zoals React/Vue/Svelte? (Voor Astro is een klein JS-script meestal het makkelijkst.)

---

import ThemeToggle from '../components/ThemeToggle.astro';
import HamburgerMenu from '../components/HamburgerMenu.astro';

interface Props {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  hideHeaderTitle?: boolean;
}

const { title, description, hideHeaderTitle = false } = Astro.props;
const currentPath = Astro.url.pathname;

let menuOpen = false;
function toggleMenu() {
  menuOpen = !menuOpen;
}
---

<!doctype html>
<html lang="nl" class="scroll-smooth">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="description" content={description} />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width" />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg" />
    <meta name="generator" content={Astro.generator} />
    <title>{title}</title>
    <script is:inline>
      // Prevent FOUC (Flash of Unstyled Content) for dark mode
      const theme = (() => {
        if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('theme')) {
          return localStorage.getItem('theme');
        }
        if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
          return 'dark';
        }
        return 'light';
      })();
      
      if (theme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
      }
    </script>
  </head>
  <body class="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-gray-950 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 flex flex-col min-h-screen transition-colors">
    <header class="bg-white/80 dark:bg-gray-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm transition-all">
      <nav class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-8 sm:px-12 lg:px-16">
        <div class="flex items-center h-16 gap-6">
          {!hideHeaderTitle && (
            <a href="/" class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors">
              Rob Lohmann
            </a>
          )}
          <div class="flex gap-8 ml-auto items-center">
            <div class="hidden md:flex gap-8 items-center">
              <a 
                href="/" 
                class={`text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors font-medium relative group ${currentPath === '/' ? 'text-primary' : ''}`}
              >
                Home
                <span class={`absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 bg-primary transition-all ${currentPath === '/' ? 'w-full' : 'w-0 group-hover:w-full'}`}></span>
              </a>
              <a 
                href="/blog" 
                class={`text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors font-medium relative group ${currentPath.startsWith('/blog') ? 'text-primary' : ''}`}
              >
                Blog
                <span class={`absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 bg-primary transition-all ${currentPath.startsWith('/blog') ? 'w-full' : 'w-0 group-hover:w-full'}`}></span>
              </a>
              <a 
                href="/portfolio" 
                class={`text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors font-medium relative group ${currentPath === '/portfolio' ? 'text-primary' : ''}`}
              >
                Portfolio
                <span class={`absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 bg-primary transition-all ${currentPath === '/portfolio' ? 'w-full' : 'w-0 group-hover:w-full'}`}></span>
              </a>
              <a 
                href="/about" 
                class={`text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors font-medium relative group ${currentPath === '/about' ? 'text-primary' : ''}`}
              >
                About
                <span class={`absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 bg-primary transition-all ${currentPath === '/about' ? 'w-full' : 'w-0 group-hover:w-full'}`}></span>
              </a>
              <ThemeToggle />
            </div>
            <div class="md:hidden flex items-center">
              <button id="hamburger-btn" type="button" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-md text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset focus:ring-primary md:hidden">
                <span class="sr-only">Open main menu</span>
                <svg class="h-6 w-6" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                  <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="mobile-menu" class="md:hidden transition-all hidden"> 
          <div class="flex flex-col gap-4 py-4 px-2 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 shadow-md">
            <a href="/" class={`text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors font-medium ${currentPath === '/' ? 'text-primary' : ''}`}>Home</a>
            <a href="/blog" class={`text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors font-medium ${currentPath.startsWith('/blog') ? 'text-primary' : ''}`}>Blog</a>
            <a href="/portfolio" class={`text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors font-medium ${currentPath === '/portfolio' ? 'text-primary' : ''}`}>Portfolio</a>
            <a href="/about" class={`text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors font-medium ${currentPath === '/about' ? 'text-primary' : ''}`}>About</a>
            <div class="flex justify-end pr-2"><ThemeToggle /></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </nav>
      <script is:inline>
        const btn = document.getElementById('hamburger-btn');
        const menu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
        if (btn && menu) {
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            menu.classList.toggle('hidden');
          });
        }
      </script>
    </header>
    <main class="flex-grow">
      <slot />
    </main>
    <footer class="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 transition-colors">
      <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-8 sm:px-12 lg:px-16 py-8">
        <p class="text-center text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-2">&copy; 2011 - {new Date().getFullYear()} Rob Lohmann. All rights reserved.</p>
        <p class="text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-500 text-sm">
          Gebouwd met 
          <a href="https://astro.build" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary hover:underline">Astro</a>, 
          <a href="https://tailwindcss.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary hover:underline">Tailwind CSS</a> en 
          <a href="https://www.typescriptlang.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary hover:underline">TypeScript</a>
        </p>
      </div>
    </footer>
  </body>
</html>

                themeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                  const element = document.documentElement;
                  element.classList.toggle('dark');
                  const isDark = element.classList.contains('dark');

---

Het probleem ontstaat doordat het hamburgermenu en het ThemeToggle component elk hun eigen event listeners toevoegen, maar als je op het hamburgermenu klikt, wordt het mobiele menu alleen getoond/verborgen—de ThemeToggle werkt dan soms niet goed, vooral als het menu opnieuw wordt toegevoegd aan de DOM of als scripts niet opnieuw worden uitgevoerd.

De beste Astro-oplossing is om het ThemeToggle-script opnieuw te initialiseren wanneer het mobiele menu wordt geopend, zodat de event listener altijd werkt. Dit kan door het ThemeToggle-script in een functie te plaatsen en die functie aan te roepen na het tonen van het menu.

Ik zal dit aanpassen in je layout. De dark/light toggle werkt nu ook als je het mobiele menu opent via het hamburgermenu. Het ThemeToggle-script wordt opnieuw geactiveerd na het tonen van het menu, zodat wisselen tussen thema's altijd functioneert.

Test gerust op mobiel en desktop. Wil je nog verdere verbeteringen?

  </svg>
  <svg id="theme-toggle-dark-icon" class="hidden w-5 h-5 text-gray-200 dark:block" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <path d="M17.293 13.293A8 8 0 016.707 2.707a8.001 8.001 0 1010.586 10.586z"></path>
  </svg>
</button>

<script>
  // Dark mode toggle functionality
  function setInitialTheme() {
    const theme = (() => {
      if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('theme')) {
        return localStorage.getItem('theme');
      }
      if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
        return 'dark';
      }
      return 'light';
    })();
    if (theme === 'dark') {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
    }
    window.localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
  }
  setInitialTheme();

  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('#theme-toggle').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const element = document.documentElement;
        element.classList.toggle('dark');
        const isDark = element.classList.contains('dark');
        localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      });
    });
  });
</script>

<script>
  // Animate skill bars on scroll
  const observerOptions = {
    threshold: 0.2,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -100px 0px'
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const bars = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.skill-bar');
        bars.forEach((bar) => {
          const level = bar.getAttribute('data-level');
          setTimeout(() => {
            (bar as HTMLElement).style.width = `${level}%`;
          }, 100);
        });
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, observerOptions);

  const skillSection = document.querySelector('section:has(.skill-bar)');
  if (skillSection) {
    observer.observe(skillSection);
  }
</script>

<section class="bg-gradient-to-br from-primary via-accent to-primary dark:from-gray-900 dark:via-gray-800 dark:to-gray-900 text-white transition-colors">
  <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-8 sm:px-12 lg:px-16 py-10 md:py-20">
    <div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center">
      <div class="space-y-6">
  <h1 class="text-5xl md:text-7xl font-extrabold mb-6 leading-tight tracking-tight hidden md:block">{name}</h1>
        <p class="text-2xl md:text-3xl text-blue-100 dark:text-gray-300 mb-6 font-light">{title}</p>
        <p class="text-lg md:text-xl text-blue-50 dark:text-gray-400 mb-10 leading-relaxed max-w-xl">{description}</p>
        
        {socials.length > 0 && (
          <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
            {socials.map((social) => (
              <a 
                href={social.url} 
                target="_blank" 
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                class="group inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-primary dark:text-white hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-xl transition-all font-medium border border-white dark:border-gray-700 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1"
              >
                <span class="group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" set:html={getIcon(social.iconType)} />
                <span>{social.name}</span>
              </a>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      
  <div class="flex justify-center md:justify-end">
        <div class="relative group">
          <div class="absolute -inset-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-secondary to-blue-400 rounded-full blur opacity-75 group-hover:opacity-100 transition duration-1000 group-hover:duration-200 animate-pulse"></div>
          <img 
            src={imageSrc} 
            alt={name}
            class="relative rounded-full shadow-2xl w-72 h-72 object-cover border-4 border-white dark:border-gray-700 ring-4 ring-white/50 dark:ring-gray-700/50"
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

Laat gerust weten als je nog meer wilt verbeteren!

// src/config/analytics.ts
const GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID = '';

export function getGoogleAnalyticsId() {
	if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
		const host = window.location.hostname;
		if (host === 'localhost' || host === '127.0.0.1') {
			return '';
		}
	}
	return GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID;
}

_**User (2026-01-28 08:35Z)**_

als ik deze key in mijn git repo commit, is dat een security risico?

---

_**Agent (model copilot/gpt-4.1)**_

Het committen van je Google Analytics key (tracking-ID, bijvoorbeeld G-XXXXXXXXXX) in je git repo is géén groot beveiligingsrisico. Deze ID is bedoeld om publiek te zijn: iedereen kan hem zien in de HTML van je live website.

Let op:
- Het is géén geheime sleutel of API-key.
- Je kunt er geen gevoelige data mee uitlezen of je Google-account mee overnemen.
- Het is alleen bedoeld om verkeer te meten op jouw site.

Wil je misbruik voorkomen (zoals spam-tracking), kun je in Google Analytics je domein als toegestane bron instellen. Maar de key zelf mag gerust in je repo staan.

    const theme = (() => {
      if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('theme')) {
        return localStorage.getItem('theme');
      }
      if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
        return 'dark';
      }
      return 'light';
    })();
    if (theme === 'dark') {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
    }
  window.localStorage.setItem('theme', theme ?? 'light');
  }
  setInitialTheme();

  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('#theme-toggle').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const element = document.documentElement;
        element.classList.toggle('dark');
        const isDark = element.classList.contains('dark');
        localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      });
    });
  });
</script>

import Layout from '../layouts/Layout.astro';
import Hero from '../components/Hero.astro';
import FeaturedPost from '../components/FeaturedPost.astro';
import { getCollection } from 'astro:content';
import { getReadingTime, isPostPublished } from '../content/config';

const allPosts = await getCollection('blog');
const publishedPosts = allPosts.filter(isPostPublished);
const sortedPosts = publishedPosts.sort((a, b) => b.data.pubDate.valueOf() - a.data.pubDate.valueOf());
const featuredPost = sortedPosts[0];

const socials = [
  { name: 'GitHub', url: 'https://github.com/roblohmann', icon: '🔗', iconType: 'github' as const },
  { name: 'LinkedIn', url: 'https://linkedin.com/in/roblohmann', icon: '💼', iconType: 'linkedin' as const },
  { name: 'Twitter', url: 'https://twitter.com/roblohmann', icon: '🐦', iconType: 'twitter' as const },
  { name: 'Facebook', url: 'https://facebook.com/roblohmann', icon: '📘', iconType: 'facebook' as const },
  { name: 'Instagram', url: 'https://instagram.com/roblohmann', icon: '📸', iconType: 'instagram' as const },
  { name: 'YouTube', url: 'https://youtube.com/@roblohmann', icon: '📺', iconType: 'youtube' as const },
];


// const featuredProjects = [
//   {
//     name: 'Voorbeeld Project 1',
//     description: 'Een uitgebreid .NET project met Azure integratie voor het beheren van cloud resources.',
//     url: 'https://github.com/roblohmann/project1',
//     technologies: ['.NET', 'Azure', 'C#', 'Docker'],
//     stars: 42,
//     forks: 12,
//   },

//     name: 'Kubernetes Tool',
//     description: 'Een handige CLI tool voor het beheren van Kubernetes clusters en het automatiseren van deployment workflows.',

//     technologies: ['Kubernetes', 'Go', 'CLI'],
//     stars: 128,
//     forks: 24,
//   },
//   {
//     name: 'PostgreSQL Utilities',
//     description: 'Een verzameling scripts en tools voor PostgreSQL database management en optimalisatie.',
//     url: 'https://github.com/roblohmann/postgres-utils',
//     technologies: ['PostgreSQL', 'Python', 'SQL'],
//     stars: 67,
//     forks: 15,
//   },
// ];

interface Project {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  url: string;
  technologies: string[];
  stars: number;
  forks: number;
}
const featuredProjects: Project[] = []
---

<Layout 
  title="Rob Lohmann - Developer Blog" 
  description="Persoonlijke blog over software development, .NET, Azure en meer"
  hideHeaderTitle={true}
>
  <Hero 
    name="Rob Lohmann"
    title="Software Developer & Cloud Enthusiast"
    description="Gepassioneerd over .NET, Azure, Kubernetes en moderne web development. Ik deel mijn kennis en ervaring op deze blog."
    socials={socials}
  />
  
  <!-- Featured Blog Post -->
  <section class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-8 sm:px-12 lg:px-16 py-16">
    <FeaturedPost 
      title={featuredPost.data.title}
      description={featuredPost.data.description}
      slug={featuredPost.slug}
      pubDate={featuredPost.data.pubDate}
      tags={featuredPost.data.tags}
      readingTime={getReadingTime(featuredPost.body)}
    />
  </section>
  
  <!-- Latest Articles -->
  <section class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-8 sm:px-12 lg:px-16 py-16">
    <h2 class="text-4xl font-bold mb-12 text-gray-900 dark:text-white border-l-4 border-primary pl-4">Laatste artikelen</h2>
    <div class="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 fade-in-section">
      {sortedPosts.slice(1, 7).map((post, index) => (
        <article 
          class="group bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-xl p-6 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-primary/10 hover:-translate-y-2 transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col"
          style={`animation-delay: ${index * 100}ms`}
        >
          <a href={`/blog/${post.slug}`} class="flex flex-col flex-grow">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-3 text-gray-900 dark:text-white group-hover:text-primary transition-colors leading-tight">
              {post.data.title}
            </h3>
            <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
              <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
              </svg>
              {post.data.pubDate.toLocaleDateString('nl-NL', {
                year: 'numeric',
                month: 'short',
                day: 'numeric'
              })}
              <span class="mx-1">•</span>
              <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path>
              </svg>
              {getReadingTime(post.body)}
            </p>
            <p class="text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-5 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3">{post.data.description}</p>
            {post.data.tags && (
              <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-auto">
                {post.data.tags.slice(0, 3).map((tag) => (
                  <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-primary dark:text-blue-300 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border border-primary/20">
                    {tag}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </a>
        </article>
      ))}
    </div>
    <div class="mt-12 text-center">
      <a href="/blog" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-8 py-4 bg-primary text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-accent transition-all font-semibold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5 text-lg">
        Bekijk alle artikelen
        <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 8l4 4m0 0l-4 4m4-4H3"></path>
        </svg>
      </a>
    </div>
  </section>

  {featuredProjects.length > 0 && (
    <section class="bg-gradient-to-b from-white to-blue-50 dark:from-gray-900 dark:to-gray-950 py-16 transition-colors">
      <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-8 sm:px-12 lg:px-16">
        <h2 class="text-4xl font-bold mb-12 text-gray-900 dark:text-white border-l-4 border-secondary pl-4">Featured Portfolio</h2>
        <div class="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {featuredProjects.map((project, index) => (
            <article 
              class="group bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-xl p-6 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-secondary/10 hover:-translate-y-2 transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col"
              style={`animation-delay: ${index * 100}ms`}
            >
              <div class="flex items-start justify-between mb-4">
                <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex-1 group-hover:text-secondary transition-colors">
                  <a href={project.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {project.name}
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
